49. Pros and Cons of School Homework

I. Advantages of School Homework 
1. Reinforcement of Learning 
One major advantage of homework is its capacity to provide 
reinforcement of newly-acquired knowledge. Classroom instruction is 
often fast-paced, and learners may struggle to absorb complex material 
within limited lesson time. Homework tasks allow students to consolidate 
understanding by revisiting concepts, engaging in additional practice, and 
identifying gaps in their comprehension. As a result, learners build long-
term retention and develop deeper cognitive connections.
